01 / ARCHITECTURAL PHILOSOPHY

DESIGNED FOR CALM,
INSPIRED BY LOCATION.

Escape the city rhythm into open green horizons. The Mokila estate offers expansive private gardens, fresh countryside air, and intimate luxury for weekend escapes and celebratory gatherings.

Low-slung pavilion architecture sits gracefully among native tamarind trees and manicured lawns, blurring inside and outside through 4-meter glass sliders and stone pergolas.
